Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a business and occupation tax exemption for nonprofit organizations that provide legal services to low-income individuals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax exemption fornonprofit organizations that provide legal services to low-incomeindividuals; and adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to nonprofit organizations primarilyengaged in the provision of legal services to lowincome individuals.For the purpose of this section, "nonprofit" means an organizationexempt from federal income tax under Title 26 U.S.C. Sec. 501(c) ofthe federal internal revenue code.
